chemistry-killer-11.topic: Reaction rate, Le Chatelier's principle and chemical cells
chemistry-killer-11.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-11.material:
For di reaction $\mathrm{N_2O_4(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NO_2(g)}$, di concentration equilibrium constant na $K = 0.4$ (units omitted) for one temperature. For dis temperature, dem put $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ and $\mathrm{NO_2}$ inside each of di following three containers and leave dem for long enough time.
(I) Volume 2.0 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.4 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.4 mol
(II) Volume 0.5 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.1 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.2 mol
(III) Volume 2.0 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.2 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.4 mol
Compare di reaction quotient $Q$ with $K$ and correctly match di direction of reaction wey go happen for each container until e reach equilibrium.

chemistry-killer-11.s.s1.explain:
